name: TiyasanCloud
description: Registers TiyasanCloud customer agents (confined, with a one-tap WhatsApp link on the shared number) and enforces their monthly token quota.
author: Evonic

variables.name: ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.label: Access token
variables.description: Shared secret the TiyasanCloud console sends as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or 'X-Access-Token'. Also signs outgoing callbacks.

variables.name: SHARED_CHANNEL_ID
variables.label: Shared WhatsApp channel (optional)
variables.description: Leave empty to use the first connected whatsapp_shared channel. Set it to pin one channel. The plugin never creates channels; an operator connects the number once.

variables.name: SHARED_NUMBER
variables.label: Shared number override (optional)
variables.description: Leave empty: the number is read from the channel's WhatsApp session. E.164 without '+'.

variables.name: MAX_LINKED_PER_AGENT
variables.label: WhatsApp numbers per agent
variables.description: How many WhatsApp numbers may chat with one customer agent (TiyasanCloud: 1).

variables.name: PAIR_CODE_TTL_MINUTES
variables.label: WhatsApp link lifetime (minutes)
variables.description: How long a 'chat on WhatsApp' link stays valid.

variables.name: AGENT_ID_PREFIX
variables.label: Managed agent id prefix
variables.description: Comma-separated prefixes of the agents this plugin manages (tc_<user> for new agents, id_<slug> for older ones). Evonic's own agents are never touched.

variables.name: ENFORCE_QUOTA
variables.label: Enforce token quota
variables.description: Off = record and report usage but never block a turn (shadow mode).

variables.name: ALLOWED_TOOLS
variables.label: Allowed tools
variables.description: Comma-separated. Only tools that run through the workplace (inside the customer's instance). Host tools such as sshc or send_file must never be listed.

variables.name: PAIRING_POLL_SECONDS
variables.label: Pairing poll interval
variables.description: How often the worker checks the shared-channel inbox for incoming pairing codes.
